name: EDIT chord key lights v6
description: Display-only chord expansion from the stock step editor at 0x2001C230, gated by active page 6, open editor, edit mode, cached note and visible primary. Uses editor +7 cursor and +12 track, stock signed octave and note-to-LED table. Preserves the installed bank index convention (indices 0..2); skips drum type 1, invalid counts and off-screen notes. OR-only writes into the seven-byte SPI frame at 0x20001E74 (stock key bit 31 uses byte 3). No input changes or SD calls. Hardware validation pending.

patches.note: Replace both stock literal loads; cave restores r0/r1.
